threads.title: Every continent sings children to sleep
threads.blurb: The most universally distributed music humans make. Same job, same hour of night, wholly different sound-worlds.

threads.title: The clave route
threads.blurb: A five-stroke key travels from Oyo through the Middle Passage, becomes rumba in Matanzas, son in Oriente, salsa in El Barrio, and a dembow in San Juan.

threads.title: The overtone singers
threads.blurb: One voice, two notes. Manipulating the harmonic series as melody was discovered independently on four continents.

threads.title: Soundsystem Atlantic
threads.blurb: Kingston's bass architecture crosses to London and keeps mutating: dub to jungle to garage to dubstep to grime, one lineage on two islands.

threads.title: The Great Migration
threads.blurb: Field holler to Delta blues to Beale Street to the South Side to Hitsville — six hundred miles north, one unbroken musical argument.

threads.title: Drone doesn't care about borders
threads.blurb: A sustained fundamental under modal ornament — Appalachia, Hardanger, the Highlands, Galicia, Essaouira, Gwalior, Arnhem Land. Your tree's first root, drawn on the ground.
